image_description: An open vintage comic book or graphic novel spread, displaying two pages of sequential art. The pages feature hand-drawn illustrations in a classic mid-20th-century style with yellowed paper stock. Panels depict various scenes including outdoor landscapes, indoor dialogues between men in suits, and a woman in a green dress. Speech bubbles and caption boxes contain legible English text. The binding is visible in the center gutter.

It is not perfectly legible real text, suggesting AI generation or low-resolution scan artifacts.
